title: bn-k222 v1 case: the state window IS the basis dimension (26 = NLOCAL); empty states cannot be added via nbands
symptom: An nbands 26->30 probe died in SCF before the first iteration: 'Number of basis (NLOCAL) < Number of electronic states (NBANDS)'. The case's orbital set (2s2p1d x 2 atoms) gives NLOCAL = 26, so the original nbands = 26 window already spans the full basis.
root_cause: For this basis there are no empty states to add by raising nbands: the window is capped by the basis dimension. Adding empty states requires a LARGER orbital set (e.g. 2s2p2d), which is a basis change and a new frozen case - the same 'extend upward means a bigger basis' conclusion as the MnF2 campaign.
minimal_fix: To study empty-state convergence or high-state pollution on BN, generate a larger-basis case (new PP/NAO set, new freeze). Never raise nbands above NLOCAL.
validation: ABACUS refuses nbands > NLOCAL at input parsing (observed run-20260913T012756Z-72f8d9b58d).
avoid: Treating nbands as a free axis on cases whose window already equals the basis; probing empty-state effects on a window-capped case.

parameters.nbands: <= NLOCAL; the bn-k222 window is already NLOCAL
